## Summary

Filipe Martins is a Senior Analytics Engineer at Omie, a Brazilian SaaS company, where he builds machine learning models and generative AI agents on Databricks. He started in 2021 automating spreadsheets in Jadlog's back office, grew into the data team as a Data Analyst, and moved into analytics engineering at Omie in 2024. In parallel he co-founded Filka Studio in 2022, a São Paulo studio that combines software development and digital design.

He works across the full path from data to software: ingestion, modeling, orchestration, machine learning, the applied AI layer on top, and the applications and integrations that deliver it to users. He is a software engineer as much as a data engineer, writing production Python, JavaScript, Apex and APIs alongside pipelines and models. His work is measured in hours returned to teams and manual processes removed, not in tools adopted.

## Availability

Open to new projects and proposals. Takes full-time roles, contract work through Filka Studio, and short freelance engagements. Works remotely and comfortable with asynchronous English communication.

## What he does

- Modern data pipelines: Databricks, AWS, dbt, Airflow, Spark. Ingestion through consumption, with observability and CI/CD.
- Applied generative AI: internal chatbots, RAG agents over company knowledge bases, LLM-driven workflow automation.
- Business machine learning: classification, regression and optimization for allocation, churn, scoring and demand forecasting.
- Salesforce and automation via Filka Studio: Apex, Flows, LWC, API integrations, CRM data quality.

## Selected work

### Smart client-to-franchise allocation — Omie, 2025
100% of routing automated. The team previously matched clients to franchises by hand. Filipe built a model that scores each client and crosses that score with every franchise profile to produce the ideal match without human intervention. Stack: Python, Scikit-learn, Databricks.

### Internal LLM chatbot — Omie, 2025
Around 400 hours per month recovered from knowledge-base searching. A RAG agent that answers questions about policies, processes and technical documentation in natural language, which also shortened onboarding for new hires. Stack: LLMs, RAG, OpenAI, Python.

### Commercial KPI ETL — Jadlog, 2023
Twelve executive dashboards consolidated onto a single source of truth. Designed the commercial data structure in Oracle and the Spark and Airflow pipelines feeding leadership's Power BI. Stack: PL/SQL, Spark, Airflow, Power BI.

### Freight table automation — Jadlog, 2023
Roughly 60 hours of manual work per week eliminated. Python scripts that format freight tables for VTEX, Intelipost and Loja Integrada, ending a recurring rework cycle. Stack: Python, Pandas.

### Tailored Salesforce — Filka Studio, 2024
Two active clients on customized Sales Cloud. Implementations, Apex and Flows automations, API integrations and executive dashboards for commercial operations. Stack: Apex, Flows, LWC, APIs.

## Filka Studio

Founded 2022, São Paulo. Co-founded by Filipe to bring together two fields that usually stay apart: software development and digital design. Services: tailored Salesforce, Python automations, websites and landing pages, brand and visual identity, business intelligence, consulting and discovery. Two active Salesforce clients. Team of 2 to 10. Site: https://filkastudio.com.br

Working method: discovery first, then a proposal with three paths (minimum viable, recommended, complete) so the client picks scope, timeline and investment. Short sprints with continuous delivery. Documentation, training and post-delivery support at handover.
